pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug
pr_body:
## Summary

- implement ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug on current main while preserving integrated ADR0135 changes
- keep Graph Debug bound to actual AnimGraphPlayer runtime evidence
- preserve the existing Animator-only animation debug snapshot contract when no Animation Graph player is present
- preserve stable graph identity/provenance, stale suppression, read-only overlays, and active transition highlighting

## Validation

Re-run affected Windows Validation and required Editor visual validation.
